deploy.rebuildingMsg: Rebuilding Docker image on Fly... this takes ~60 seconds.
deploy.driftTitle: Sync endpoint is out of date
deploy.driftBody: Your Fly container runs sync-endpoint v{version}, but cms-admin now bundles v{expected}. Rebuild to get the latest fixes.
deploy.wizardIntro: Deploy a new site to Fly.io with a few clicks — pick a template, configure, and go.
deploy.autoConfigured: Your site has a build pipeline and a connected GitHub account, so it will deploy to GitHub Pages automatically. Pick a different provider above to override.
deploy.descVercel: Recommended for Next.js and static sites. Supports SSR, API routes, and edge functions.
deploy.descNetlify: Supports Next.js via adapter, static sites, and serverless functions.
deploy.descFly: Docker-based rebuild on every deploy. Best for SSR apps (Next.js, Remix) that genuinely need Docker. Slow for content edits — use Fly.io Live for static sites.
deploy.descFlyLive: Your site runs on Fly.io. The first deploy takes about a minute; every edit after goes live in under a second. Best for EU hosting.
deploy.descFlyEphemeral: A short-lived Fly Machine builds a container image (Next.js standalone, Bun + Hono, or your own Dockerfile) and pushes to GHCR, then your target Fly app rolls to the new tag. Requires GHCR_PUSH_TOKEN + FLY_API_TOKEN secrets on cms-admin.
deploy.descCloudflare: Legacy webhook-only — just POSTs to a Cloudflare Pages deploy hook URL. Prefer 'Cloudflare Pages (direct)' for full integration.
deploy.descCfPages: Direct Cloudflare Pages API upload. 300+ global edge PoPs, free tier covers most small sites. Fastest option for pure-static sites worldwide.
deploy.descGithubReady: Ready to deploy — GitHub connected. A repository will be created automatically if needed, and your site files pushed to GitHub Pages in one click.
deploy.descGithubManual: Static files only. Connect GitHub above, or provide a token and repository manually.
deploy.descCustom: Any service that accepts a POST request to trigger a build.
deploy.hookVercel: Vercel → Project → Settings → Git → Deploy Hooks
deploy.hookNetlify: Netlify → Site → Build & deploy → Build hooks
deploy.hookCloudflare: Cloudflare → Pages → Settings → Builds → Deploy hooks
deploy.hookCustom: Any URL that accepts a POST request to trigger a build
deploy.orgHelp: Fly.io org slug — auto-detected from token if left empty
deploy.regionHelp: Fly region code for the volume. Cannot be changed after first deploy.
deploy.syncSecretHelp: HMAC secret shared with the Fly container. Generated on first deploy. Rotate from the "Rebuild infrastructure" action (not yet in UI — use CLI or regenerate manually).
deploy.projectNameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Auto-created on first deploy if missing.
deploy.notProvisioned: Not provisioned yet. Click {deployNow} below to spin up the Fly app and volume. After that, this card will show the server status and a {rebuild} button.
deploy.rebuildHelp: Pushes a fresh Docker image (web server + sync endpoint). Content on the volume is preserved. Takes ~60 s.
deploy.githubIntro: GitHub Pages hosts your site for free. Connect your GitHub account and the CMS will create a repository and deploy automatically.
deploy.step2Help: Authorizes the CMS to create a repository and push your site files.
deploy.step3Help: The CMS creates the repo, builds your site, and enables GitHub Pages — all in one click.
